prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1278; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Records show long-standing treatment for the same condition before the crash; most of the current complaints come from it.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of shoulder pain and restricted motion. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm injury to the shoulder. Over 18 visits, treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury, with gradual gains in range of motion and strength. Review of the records also shows long-standing treatment for the same shoulder condition before this collision, and much of the current complaint appears to stem from that prior condition rather than the acute event. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. Recommendations include continuing the home exercise program, reassessing for residual symptoms, and separating current findings from the pre-existing condition in any future functional evaluation.
